title: Move Night Roster AI to the Groq free tier
summary: Night Roster AI now targets Groq's free-tier Responses API with GPT-OSS 20B, keeping the provider credential exclusively in the Supabase Edge Function and retaining the deterministic roster summary whenever the free AI service is unavailable or its quota is exhausted.
changes: Moves server-side Night Roster AI requests from the paid OpenAI API endpoint to Groq's OpenAI-compatible Responses API.
Uses openai/gpt-oss-20b as the default model and low reasoning effort to keep requests within Groq free-tier limits while preserving concise roster-grounded answers.
Keeps GROQ_API_KEY entirely inside the authenticated Supabase Edge Function so no provider credential is exposed to the browser or installed PWA.
Preserves the deterministic roster engine as the authority and automatically falls back to the existing roster summary when Groq is unavailable, unconfigured, rate-limited or offline.
Adds regression checks preventing accidental browser-side Groq calls or a return to a paid OpenAI API dependency.
